Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to successfully retrieve the content of the authoritative source (Britannica) and instead returned a search results page (DuckDuckGo). This is a critical failure in the "Information Retrieval" phase. The task required extracting specific quotes and definitions from Britannica to validate the hypothesis about plateau formation. By only showing the search results page and not navigating to the actual article or extracting the text, the agent provided no usable evidence to the Planner. This forced the Planner into a repetitive loop of issuing identical instructions to gather the same missing information, creating an inefficient "search loop" where no actual data synthesis occurred.
